name: agent-testing
author: lobehub
description: Agentic end-to-end testing for any project: backend verification via the project CLI, frontend verification via agent-browser (web), and desktop verification via CDP (Electron). Drives the real surface, captures visually confirmed evidence, and publishes a structured report to the LobeHub verify platform. Triggers on 'cli test', 'test with cli', 'verify with cli', 'backend test with cli', 'local test', 'test in electron', 'test desktop', 'manual test', 'test report', or any local end-to-end verification task.
